content.thinking: The assertion failed because `core[:1]` is `{` and `core[1:]` starts with `"version"` — my slicing: `core[:1] + ' '*pad + core[1:]` gives length 1 + pad + (len(core)-1) = pad + len(core) = target - 2 + ... let me recompute: pad = target - len(core) - 2 → total = 1 + pad + len(core) - 1 = pad + len(core) = target - 2. So it's 2 short. Fix: pad = target - len(core).

arguments.command:
cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json
req = json.load(open('stress9.json'))
core = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
target = 8388608
pad = target - len(core.encode())
text = core[:1] + ' ' * pad + core[1:]
assert len(text.encode()) == target, len(text.encode())
open('big_exact.json', 'w').write(text)
text2 = core[:1] + ' ' * (pad + 1) + core[1:]
open('big_over.json', 'w').write(text2)
print('exact', len(text.encode()), 'over', len(text2.encode()))
PYEOF
cd /app/dev && echo "== exact 8388608"; (time /app/submission/run.sh < big_exact.json > outbig.json) 2>&1|grep -E "real|user"; head -c 60 outbig.json; echo; echo "== 8388609 -> E_LIMIT"; (time /app/submission/run.sh < big_over.json) 2>&1|grep -E "real|error"
